Art born
from what
makes you feel.
hero.lead: Handmade textured art pieces made from your story
hero.alt: Textured art.aneris piece in deep red tones

idea.titol:
It can all begin
with one small detail.
idea.text: At art.aneris the starting point isn’t only the memory, it’s what it made you feel. The sea, Montserrat, a forest — or even something that keeps resonating inside you.

lloc.text: That landscape or space you’ll always want to go back to.

ruta.text: A walk, a summit or a day that meant far more than the kilometres.

momentVital.text: A life moment you don’t want time to erase.

sensacio.text: A colour, a chapter or an emotion you might not know how to put into words.

formes.eyebrow: How do you want to live art.aneris?
formes.titol: One idea. Four ways to make it real

encarrecs.text: A memory, a place or a moment turned into a piece created specifically for you.

rutes.titol: I want to immortalise a route
rutes.text: The mountain, the track and the meaning of a day you don’t want to forget.

regals.titol: I want to capture a memory
regals.text: You give the beginning. The piece is then created with whoever receives it.

cocreacio.titol: I want to make it myself
cocreacio.text: Learn, experiment and create textures with my help.

proces.titol: You bring the story. I give it form.
proces.text: You don’t need to know what the piece should look like before you write to me.

partida.cita: It’s our anniversary and I want to give her a little piece of the sea. She always goes there with our dog Meeko when she needs quiet and a break from the noise of everyday life. I want her to have that feeling at home too.
partida.peu: You tell me what’s behind it: what happened, why it’s important and what you wouldn’t want to lose over time.

interpretacio.alt: Detail with footprints on a textured piece inspired by the sea
interpretacio.peu: I look for a composition that keeps the essence without spelling it out. Silhouettes, layers, paths, textures and colours turn the story into matter.

obra.alt: Living room with a textured art.aneris sea piece
obra.peu: Your story stops living in your head or in a photograph. It becomes a piece made to have a place in your home.

rutes.titol: Some routes last far longer than the day you walk them.
rutes.text: Send me a Strava route, a summit or a walk that mattered. The track, the profile of the mountain, the landscape and what that day meant to you become a one-of-a-kind piece.
rutes.nota: The route stops being data stored inside an app.

pas1.peu: The original track is where the piece begins.
pas1.alt: Map with the original route track

pas2.peu: I turn the track into a proposal of relief, landscape and colour before taking it to the canvas.
pas2.alt: Interpretation of the relief and the landscape from the route

pas3.peu: The route ends up as a piece made to remember far more than the kilometres.
pas3.alt: Finished textured piece inspired by the route

rutes.segell: The story carries on, on your wall

regals.titol: Give the beginning. We’ll create the piece later.
regals.text: Some gifts are too personal to decide entirely on someone else’s behalf. If you want to give a piece but would rather the person receiving it took part in creating it, you can give the beginning of the story.

pas1.peu: A gift that says there is a piece waiting to be made.
pas1.alt: Gift wrapped in kraft paper with dried flowers and an art.aneris tag

pas2.peu: Whoever receives it, or the two of you together, tell me what you would like to turn into a piece.
pas2.alt: Two people around a table with sketches, photographs and colour samples

pas3.peu: That story takes shape in a piece created specifically for them.
pas3.alt: Relief piece of mountains in terracotta tones resting on a wooden shelf

tallers.titol: You won’t come to repeat the same painting as everyone else.
tallers.text: In every workshop you’ll learn the technique, but the piece will be yours. You’ll decide the composition, the textures and the colours, so you leave with a work you actually want to hang at home.
tallers.acompanyament: I’m with you throughout the process so you can make your own creative decisions instead of standing in front of the canvas not knowing where to begin.

ideaClara.questio: Do I need to know exactly how I want the piece?
ideaClara.resposta: No. You can come with just a story, a photograph, a route, a place or a feeling. Part of the process is precisely finding a way to turn what it means to you into a visual proposal.

encarrec.questio: How does a custom commission work?
encarrec.resposta: First you tell me what you want to turn into a piece and what lies behind it. Then we settle the starting point, the format and the approach before I begin creating it. You don’t need to have every decision made before you write to me. We talk it through and give it shape together.

preu.questio: How much does a piece cost?
preu.resposta: Every piece is different. The price depends mainly on the size, the format, the technique and the kind of personalisation. Once you tell me what you have in mind, I can guide you through the options that best fit your idea and put a proposal together for you.

termini.questio: How long does it take to be ready?
termini.resposta: It depends on the kind of piece and on when you place the commission. Before starting I’ll give you an approximate timeframe so you know when you can have it. If you need it for a particular date, tell me when you write.

strava.questio: Can I create a piece from a Strava route?
strava.resposta: Yes. You can send me the route or a screenshot with the details of the track. The track becomes the starting point for building the composition and connecting it to the relief, the landscape and the story of that day.

regal.questio: Can I gift a piece without deciding it for the other person?
regal.resposta: Yes. With A gift in two steps, you give the beginning and the piece is created afterwards with the person who receives it. That way they can take part in the creative decisions and turn a story of their own into a piece made especially for them.

tallers.questio: Are the workshops for people with experience?
tallers.resposta: No previous experience needed. You’ll learn the technique and have support throughout the process, but the composition, the textures, the colours and the final piece will be yours.

peu.lema: Textured art that turns memories, places, routes and life moments into pieces with meaning.
